maturity_class: userspace-validated source telemetry; kernel execution remains unvalidated

compatibility.prefix: The first 120 columns retain the v6 order.
compatibility.append_only: coordination_semantics_version is appended as column 121 and must equal 7.
compatibility.reader_contract: Readers must require the exact ordered header and metrics_schema value.

metric_identities.S1: bounded signal fidelity, freshness, calibrated confidence, and accepted-reader reach
metric_identities.S2: S2_selected; only eligible workers accepting the current signal sequence can comply
metric_identities.S3: S3_conditioned; worker coherence is computed within equal discretized state
metric_identities.S4: min(1-change_fraction, S4_burst), with first decisions excluded from change counts
metric_identities.Q: (S1*S2*S3*S4)^(1/4), or exactly zero when any factor is zero

zero_denominator_policy.eligible_workers: S2 and S3 are 1 when no eligible worker exists
zero_denominator_policy.changed_workers: change fractions are 0 and S4 is 1 when no prior action exists or no worker changes

claim_limit: This schema distinguishes userspace action requests from effects. It is not evidence of BPF verifier acceptance, sched_ext attachment, actual kernel CPU placement, or real-machine safety.
